title: sideritis granatensis
intro: Sideritis granatensis, commonly known as Spanish ironwort, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis granatensis include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress, and improving respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
